svg.text: The mall around the store: concourse, shops, mezzanine and routes (metres; +x on the LEFT)
GROUND-FLOOR CONCOURSE: the atrium floor, 68 m long, 17.1 m wide, roof at 10 m
FIRST-FLOOR WALKWAY outside the glass (floor at 4.4 m); glass balustrade at its edge, you can step out and look down
FIRST-FLOOR walkway opposite (floor at 4.4 m, level with the store), glass balustrade on the atrium side
opposite shopfronts: ground floor and first floor

Green: people on the ground floor below, and two window-shoppers on the walkway. Red: customers who come along the walkway, in through the opening, look at tables and leave. Olive: people on the opposite first-floor walkway.
Everyone is placed by the shared server clock, so all visitors see the same people in the same places. The opposite walkway and neighbouring shops are not enterable.
Sizes of the concourse, the neighbours and the mezzanine are assumed; only the store itself comes from the reference photographs.
